checks.name: Every named current production manifest has explicit effect/cancel/deadline; unknown registration fails closed
Normal result and fifth Pi context pass through, cleanup releases registry and listeners
SDK input schema rejects missing/extra/wrong fields before any dispatch or admission
Signal-ignoring write times out with unknown effect, never retries, and retains actual registry until real settlement
Caller cancellation settles ignoring tool promptly and suppresses late progress across a new run
Pre-aborted call dispatches no work and acquires no stale registry
Synchronous tool throw and late rejection are drained without wedging the race
Teacher waiting pauses active deadline via existing budget; cancellation remains effective during the wait
Safe web network failure retries once with a distinct internal attempt ID; same logical call is admitted only once
429 exhausts exactly two attempts; authentication/401/403/permission never retry
Local write, parsing cache and image upload never automatically retry their transient errors
Same-call repetition executes once; changed args conflict; a new run has independent identity
Process-wide resource fence blocks another session writer after timeout until actual work settles, with zero blocked delivery
Concurrent safe reads share a lock; a same-resource writer is refused while reads are pending
Attempt persistence failure prevents a second safe-read dispatch and drains registry
Malformed and oversized output is rejected; public attempts refuse private fields and fake success
Typed projection records attempts under only matching tool ID and preserves failure across terminal events
A blocked local read rechecks the resource once after settlement and is admitted only when dispatchable
Stop during a resource-busy retry wait delivers no local read or admission

scope: Actual execution-bound and native timers/registry/SDK schema; synthetic tools, no provider or UI claim
